title: Maligned
html_source:
In a position of authority but not catholic.

The passage “guiltless though maligned” could also refer to Best’s chiding look, which after going from A.E. to Eglinton is resting on Lyster (“maligned”). The latter, however, has yet to join the debate (“[still] guiltless”).
